list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Discrete Sm6 clusters have a nearly octahedral metal framework with all 12 edges spanned by borohydride bridges. The crystal contains C2-symmetric hexamers with approximately symmetric bridges and inversion-symmetric hexamers with asymmetric bridges.

synthesis.procedure: Under argon, purified Sm(BH4)3(THF)3 and Cp*′K were combined in a flame-dried vessel. Toluene was condensed at −78 °C; the mixture was warmed to room temperature and stirred for 7 h. After filtration and solvent removal, the crude 1a was extracted with pentane. On storage it changed to a coral-colored material; redissolution in pentane and standing overnight afforded crystals identified by X-ray diffraction as 2a.
synthesis.temperature: Toluene condensed at −78 °C; reaction and crystallization at room temperature
synthesis.time: 7 h reaction; overnight crystallization after storage for several days
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Flame-dried vessel connected to a vacuum line; argon atmosphere
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filter salts, remove toluene under vacuum, extract with pentane (15 mL), then redissolve the transformed material in pentane (5 mL) and stand overnight.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The neodymium analogue is isostructural with 2a: discrete, approximately octahedral Nd6 frameworks have borohydride bridges across all 12 metal-framework edges. Symmetric and asymmetric bridging arrangements occur in distinct crystallographic hexamers.

synthesis.procedure: Under argon, purified Nd(BH4)3(THF)3 and Cp*′K were stirred overnight in THF at room temperature. The filtered solution was evaporated to give crude 1b. A portion of this powder was dissolved in boiling pentane; after removal of residual salts and standing for 24 h at room temperature, blue crystals of 2b were collected.
synthesis.temperature: Room-temperature reaction; boiling pentane dissolution followed by room-temperature crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filter salts, rinse with THF (2 × 5 mL), evaporate, dissolve 100 mg of crude 1b in boiling pentane, remove residual salts, and stand at room temperature.
synthesis.yield: Crude 1b: 333 mg (71%); crystal yield not reported

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A discrete, chairlike Sm6 hexamer comprises two Sm3Cl5(THF) fragments joined by two bridging borohydrides. Each Sm3Cl5 unit contains three μ2- and two μ3-bridging chlorides; its chloride framework is described as a hexagonal bipyramid.

synthesis.procedure: A samarium-analogue preparation similar to the quantitatively specified 2b′ procedure used Sm(BH4)3(THF)3 containing residual chloride and Cp*′K in THF. Red crystals formed among a coral-pink powder; one crystal was identified by X-ray diffraction as 2a′. The authors note that the uncontrolled chloride contamination makes these procedures illustrative rather than reproducible standard preparations.

synthesis.time: Overnight stirring in the analogous 2b′ procedure
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: A similar samarium procedure gave red, well-formed crystals among a coral-pink powder.
synthesis.yield: Low yield; no numerical value reported

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A discrete, chairlike Nd6 hexamer consists of two Nd3Cl5(THF) fragments symmetrically linked by two μ2-borohydride bridges. Each trinuclear chloride unit has three μ2- and two μ3-bridging chlorides. The compound differs from the Sm analogue 2a′ in ligand and THF conformations.

synthesis.procedure: Under argon, chloride-contaminated Nd(BH4)3(THF)3 and Cp*′K were stirred overnight in THF at room temperature. Following filtration and evaporation, the crude solid was extracted with pentane. Filtration and concentration produced pale-blue crystals, one of which was identified as 2b′. The authors state that the variable chloride contamination precludes treating this as a standard preparative procedure.

reagents.name: neodymium tris(borohydride) THF adduct containing residual chloride

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filter salts, evaporate the THF solution, extract the crude solid with pentane (10 mL), filter again, and concentrate to one-third of the volume.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The crystal associates a borohydride-only Sm6 hexamer of the type found in 2a with a distinct Sm6(BH4)2Cl10(THF)2 hexamer of the type found in 2a′. The latter has two Sm3Cl5(THF) units linked by borohydride bridges. These are separate molecular hexamers, not a single Sm12 metal core.

synthesis.procedure: Crystals were obtained under conditions similar to the quantitatively specified 2b′ procedure, but using a different sample of Sm(BH4)3(THF)3, described as apparently less chloride-contaminated than the sample that produced 2a′. The authors do not give separate amounts or a separate yield for 2a″ and caution that chloride contamination was uncontrolled.
